subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Selecionar, elaborar e utilizar instrumentos de coleta de dados e informações (questionários, enquetes, mapeamentos, opinários) e de tratamento e análise dos conteúdos obtidos, que atendam adequadamente a diferentes objetivos de pesquisa.

components.description_pt: Selecionar um instrumento de coleta de dados—questionário, survey ou pesquisa de opinião—adequado a um objetivo de pesquisa específico
components.description_en: Select a data-collection instrument—questionnaire, survey, or opinion poll—suited to a specific research objective
components.cc_component_description: Assess the usefulness of each source in answering a specific research question

components.description_pt: Elaborar um instrumento de coleta de dados que aborde adequadamente objetivos de pesquisa definidos
components.description_en: Design a data-collection instrument that adequately addresses defined research objectives
components.cc_component_description: Formulate a focused research question to guide a short research project

components.description_pt: Aplicar métodos para processar e analisar conteúdo obtido de instrumentos de coleta de dados
components.description_en: Apply methods for processing and analyzing content obtained from data-collection instruments
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate whether scientific reasoning adequately supports conclusions drawn from data or evidence

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret scientific explanations by
* Defining investigable questions or design problems based on observations, information, __and/or data__ about a phenomenon
* __Determining central ideas__ in complex evidence and information to help explain how or why a phenomenon occurs
* __Evaluating scientific reasoning that shows why data or evidence adequately supports conclusions__

Gather relevant information from multiple authoritative print and digital sources, using advanced searches effectively; assess the usefulness of each source in answering the research question; integrate information into the text selectively to maintain the flow of ideas, avoiding plagiarism and following a standard format for citation.

Conduct short research projects to answer a question (including a self-generated question), drawing on several sources and generating additional related, focused questions that allow for multiple avenues of exploration.
